audit.whatIsWrong: CROSS-LAYER DISAGREEMENT on rows 3-6: phases[].side reads Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze while every content win[N] reads Aurora.
audit.why: The full-layer progression is the correct one and the prose on both layers already argues for it: Aurora owns levels 1-3 because Spell Flux and Rune Prison are 615 range against her 900 Q, it evens out at 4-6 (Realm Warp is a delayed 3000-unit portal, not a duel tool), and it tips to Ryze from first item on because Arcane Mastery converts bonus mana into damage — content 'late' says outright the matchup flips once he has three items. A flat all-Aurora chart contradicts that sentence on the same page. Moved win[3..6] to match the sides and rewrote whys[3..6] in the same proposal so each row's sentence matches its new verdict.
audit.corrected: Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Ryze

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why and phases[3..6].why are the stock Aurora template — phases[3] and [4] sat above 'Skill' rows and phases[5] and [6] above 'Ryze' rows while describing Aurora winning.
audit.why: Ryze's real spike is items, not levels: his passive turns bonus mana into damage, so the first-item and two-item rows belong to him, while levels 4-6 are decided by who lands first. Every rewritten why now agrees with the side above it.
audit.corrected: Five whys rewritten against Ryze's ranges and his mana scaling.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is already stated correctly and matches Riot's text: Rune Prison (W, 615 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9) only ROOTS a target already carrying Spell Flux — without Flux it is just a slow. Overload (Q) is 1000 range on 5s and its cooldown RESETS off his other basic abilities, which the cooldowns field states. Spell Flux (E) is 615 range on 3.5s down to 2.5s, so the step into your 900 range is the tell for the whole chain.

The packet flags 'Your Between Worlds' in spikes[1].text as a probable wrong name. Between Worlds is Aurora's own R and the phrase is correct English, not a fabricated ability — packet false positive, no edit.

edits.after: Levels 4-5 come down to who lands first — Flux at 615 makes his root real, your 900 Q taxes the step-up.

edits.after: Two items of bonus mana make the chain lethal — break it at Spell Flux, because you no longer out-trade him straight.

notes: The chart edits are one atomic group: win[3..6] move to match the full-layer sides that were already Skill/Skill/Ryze/Ryze, and whys[3..6] plus phases[3..6].why are rewritten in the same proposal so no row argues with its own sentence.
